mapper.sql: id, verification_id AS verificationId, user_id AS userId, report_reason AS reportReason, source_url AS sourceUrl, report_draft AS reportDraft, original_image_included AS originalImageIncluded, heatmap_included AS heatmapIncluded, ai_report_draft_included AS aiReportDraftIncluded, original_name AS originalName, verdict, score, file_name AS fileName, content_type AS contentType, status, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generated_report ( verification_id, user_id, report_reason, source_url, report_draft, original_image_included, heatmap_included, ai_report_draft_included, original_name, verdict, score, file_name, content_type, status ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{userId}, #{reportReason}, #{sourceUrl}, #{reportDraft}, #{originalImageIncluded}, #{heatmapIncluded}, #{aiReportDraftIncluded}, #{originalName}, #{verdict}, #{score}, #{fileName}, COALESCE(#{contentType}, 'application/pdf'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'READY') )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM generated_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
